skill.name: skill-lookup
skill.description: Finds Agent Skills in the prompts.chat registry, retrieves selected skill files, and guides installation into Claude skill folders through MCP tools.
skill.summary: Discover and install prompts.chat Agent Skills with guided MCP lookup.
skill.author: f

security_audit.summary: The static external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, paths, and examples; no Ruby or shell execution appears in SKILL.md. Semantic review found real risk in the installation workflow because it retrieves third-party skill files and writes them into Claude skill folders without safety review, filename validation, or clear trust boundaries.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval after showing source, files, and safety notes before writing any retrieved skill files.

remediation.issue: No safety review step before installation
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to inspect SKILL.md, scripts, and configuration for prompt injection, network access, filesystem writes, and external commands.

remediation.issue: Returned filenames are not constrained in the instructions
remediation.suggestion: Normalize filenames and reject absolute paths, parent directory traversal, unsupported file types, and writes outside the selected skill directory.

static_findings.snippet: 1. Search for skills matching the user's request using `search_skills`
3. If the user picks a skill, retrieve it with `get_skill` to get all files
4. Install by saving files to `.claude/skills/{slug}/` and verify the SKILL.md exists
- `get_skill` - Get a specific skill by ID with all its files
- `query`: The search keywords from the user's request

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Skill Installation Without Safety Review
semantic_findings.description: The workflow retrieves all files from a registry and saves them into Claude skill folders without requiring safety review. Third-party skills can include prompt instructions, helper scripts, and configuration that later influence assistant behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 54-69 state that retrieved metadata includes all file contents, helper scripts, and configuration, then instruct saving each file. The risk follows directly from installing untrusted agent components without review guidance.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated File Name Writes During Installation
semantic_findings.description: The installation instructions map returned file names into the skill directory without path validation guidance. A malicious registry entry could use unexpected paths unless installers reject traversal and absolute paths.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 64-68 instruct saving each returned file under a filename placeholder, but do not mention filename normalization. This is an inferred risk because the actual MCP implementation may apply its own validation.

content.value_statement: Finding reusable agent skills across a registry can take manual browsing and file handling. This skill searches prompts.chat, retrieves selected files, and guides installation into Claude skill folders.
actual_capabilities: Search prompts.chat skills by keyword, category, tag, and result limit.
Retrieve a selected skill by ID with metadata and file contents.
Present results with title, description, author, file list, category, tags, and link.
Install retrieved files into the Claude skills folder for a selected slug.
Verify that the main skill file exists and has intact frontmatter.
Explain what an installed skill does and when it activates.
limitations: Requires prompts.chat MCP tools to be available in the agent environment.
Does not include an offline registry or local search index.
Does not validate third-party skill safety before installation.
Documents Claude skill installation paths, not other agent runtimes.

use_cases.title: Build a Personal Skill Set
use_cases.description: Find reusable skills for daily coding, writing, or research work and install selected options.

use_cases.title: Curate Team Skill Recommendations
use_cases.description: Search a registry category and compare candidates before sharing approved skill choices with a team.

use_cases.title: Research Skill Design Patterns
use_cases.description: Retrieve existing skill files to study structure, metadata, instructions, and supporting documents.

prompt_templates.title: Find Skills by Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Agent Skills for code review and show the best options with authors and file counts.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Skill Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for documentation skills, compare five results, and recommend one for writing API guides.

prompt_templates.title: Install a Selected Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the skill I selected, save its files into the Claude skills folder, then verify the main skill file.

prompt_templates.title: Curate a Safe Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the registry for testing skills, shortlist reusable options, and identify installation risks before any install.

output_examples.output: A ranked list of matching skills with title, author, description, file count, category, tags, and source link.
The selected files are saved, the main skill file is checked, and a short activation summary is provided.
A concise comparison of candidate skills, including scope, included files, and suggested next action.

best_practices: Review retrieved skill files before installing them.
Use category and tag filters to keep search results focused.
Verify the main skill file after installation.
anti_patterns: Installing unknown skills without reading the retrieved files.
Using broad searches when a category or tag would narrow results.
Assuming this skill verifies third-party registry content.

faq.question: What registry does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the prompts.chat registry through MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it install a skill for Claude?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve files and guide installation into the Claude skills folder.

faq.question: Does it work without MCP tools?
faq.answer: No. Search and retrieval depend on the prompts.chat MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it verify that a third-party skill is safe?
faq.answer: No. Users should inspect retrieved files before installation.

faq.question: What information appears in search results?
faq.answer: Results include title, description, author, file list, category, tags, and link.

faq.question: Can it help skill authors?
faq.answer: Yes. Authors can retrieve example skills and study their structure.
